responsibility: This file implements GCC’s option suggestion and shell-completion engine around the generated command-line option tables. It defines option_proposer’s logic for lazily building a cached vector of candidate spellings from cl_options and cl_enums, including enum-valued options, target-specific option values obtained through targetm_common.get_valid_option_values, and special handling for sanitizer option arguments, then uses spellcheck matching to suggest the closest valid option for an unrecognized switch and to enumerate prefix matches for the driver’s -completion= support.
same_name_distinction: Implements the opt-suggestions companion header’s declared option_proposer behavior: it builds and caches suggestion/completion candidates from cl_options, enum values, target-specific valid values, and sanitizer suboptions, and runs the actual closest-match and prefix-completion logic. Unlike gcc/opt-suggestions.h, this is the executable engine rather than the class/interface declaration.
